jobs.title: Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)
jobs.qualification: Passed Secondary School Certificate examination from a recognized Board/Institution; Knowledge of Konkani & English.
jobs.apply: Prescribed application forms are available at the office of Village Panchayat Nuvem Salcete Goa between 10.00 hrs to 13.00 hrs and 14.00 hrs to 17.30 hrs on all working days on payment of Rs 50 per form. Personally submit completed form along with documents to the O/o V.P. Nuvem on or before 09/10/2026. Applications by post/courier will not be accepted.
jobs.description: Age: Not exceeding 45 years (relaxable for Govt. servants upto 5 years; relaxable for Gen/OBC/ST/Govt. servants as per Government circular instruction). Must be registered with Employment Exchange in Goa and possess a 15-year continuous residence certificate issued by the Mamlatdar.

jobs.title: Junior Stenographer Group "C" Non-Gazetted
jobs.company: Sewerage & Infrastructural Development Corporation of Goa Ltd.
jobs.qualification: Higher Secondary School Certificate from a recognized Board or AICTE approved Diploma; Speed of 100 wpm in Short Hand and 35 wpm in typing; Minimum 6 months certificate course in Computers; Knowledge of Konkani; At least 1 year working experience in equivalent field. Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi.
jobs.apply: Physical mode only: Fill prescribed Application Form along with Declaration from website www.sidcgl.goa.gov.in and submit to the Managing Director, Sewerage & Infrastructural Development Corporation of Goa Ltd., Ishan Bldg., 2nd floor, Opp. CCP, Panaji - Goa 403001 by 19/10/2026 till 5 pm.
jobs.description: Notice inviting applications for filling up of the post of Junior Stenographer Group 'C' Non-Gazetted by Direct Recruitment on Regular Establishment. Age limit prescribed: Not exceeding 45 years.
